title: Study workflow
evidence_boundary: Counts represent screens or combinations, not independent discoveries

title: PBC genome-wide anchoring
evidence_boundary: TYK2 locus labeling does not imply cell-specific colocalization

title: IL12RB2 regional association
evidence_boundary: LD derives from an external European reference panel

title: IL12RB2 credible sets
evidence_boundary: Conditional inclusion probabilities are model- and LD-dependent

title: PBC multi-signal architecture
evidence_boundary: Summary-statistic fine-mapping used external signed LD

title: Discovery signal sharing
evidence_boundary: Convergent L=3 eQTL review used because L=10 did not converge

title: External eQTL signal-level replication
evidence_boundary: Nathan Th1 does not replicate the principal signal and defines a cell-context boundary

title: FinnGen replication at three resolutions
evidence_boundary: Gene-level evidence is FDR-significant but not Bonferroni-significant; sample-level overlap was not directly verified

title: Wakefield ABF and regional compatibility
evidence_boundary: BF-BF is a single-causal regional approximation, not formal FinnGen coloc.susie

title: Disease–RNA–protein direction
evidence_boundary: CSF protein is directionally discordant and compartment/assay-specific; no formal mediation claim

title: Same-sample platform pQTL comparison
evidence_boundary: Olink and SomaScan effect scales are platform-specific and not directly interchangeable

title: Cross-platform cis-window concordance
evidence_boundary: Weak correlation and low ABF PP.H4 may reflect epitope, fragment, PAV/PTM or assay effects

title: TYK2 functional-variant meta
evidence_boundary: Lifelong genetic perturbation is not equivalent to drug exposure

title: TYK2 two-variant distinction
evidence_boundary: Summary-z approximation with external 1000G EUR LD; not individual-level COJO

title: TYK2 LD bootstrap
evidence_boundary: 1000G FIN is not FinnGen study-specific signed LD; rare-allele monomorphic draws were excluded

title: Donor-aware liver atlas
primary_source: HRA008003 SoupX-corrected counts; target-independent SingleR labels
evidence_boundary: UMAP is visualization only and is not used for disease inference

title: SingleR and marker support
primary_source: HRA008003 target-independent SingleR; canonical marker expression
evidence_boundary: SingleR target genes were excluded from annotation training to avoid circularity

title: IL12RB2 pathway localization
evidence_boundary: Cell-level expression is descriptive; donor-level models provide inference

title: Donor-level NK composition
primary_source: Per-donor lrNK and cNK cell counts
evidence_boundary: Five donors per group; exact permutation P=0.508

title: Donor-level pathway pseudobulk
evidence_boundary: Most target effects are exploratory and do not pass transcriptome-wide FDR; CD8 T STAT4 is the exception

title: IL12RB2 robustness
primary_source: edgeR robust QL; exact donor permutation; leave-one-donor-out
evidence_boundary: Direction stability is not independent external replication; n=5+5

title: Within-PBC antigen-context test
primary_source: GSE270739 pure-PBC paired PDC-E2 and foreign-antigen pseudobulk
evidence_boundary: Mean paired effect is positive but unsupported: exact sign-flip P = 0.500; this is not PBC-versus-healthy replication

title: External liver single-cell cohorts
primary_source: J Hepatol atlas; HRA002347 5-prime; HRA008003 donor-level lrNK-minus-cNK contrasts
evidence_boundary: The J Hepatol estimate is imprecise; HRA002347 3-prime reuses the 5-prime donors and is excluded from independent counting

title: Cross-cohort meta-validation
evidence_boundary: HK one-sided P=0.079; I2=98.4%; tau2=2.536; do not claim definitive replication

title: Systematic external-resource audit
primary_source: Public PBC single-cell dataset audit through October 20, 2026
evidence_boundary: Overlapping donors, condition-level technical units and unavailable reusable matrices are explicitly distinguished

title: Bulk pathway meta-analysis
evidence_boundary: Neither pathway reaches multiplicity-adjusted significance; this is directional pathway support, not formal transcriptomic replication

title: PXD083842 proteomic robustness and confounding
evidence_boundary: Age, sex, BMI, concurrent MASLD and recruitment-stream confounding limit causal and disease-specific interpretation; exact non-significant adjusted coefficients are unavailable

title: Drug and clinical evidence matrix
evidence_boundary: No TYK2-directed PBC trial was identified; ustekinumab failed its week-12 ALP response endpoint and the baricitinib study terminated after two participants

title: Safety and druggability gates
evidence_boundary: Liver enzymes, serious infection and tuberculosis require gating; Child-Pugh C is not recommended; direct IL12RB2 small-molecule docking is NO-GO without a validated ligand-bound pocket

title: Final evidence grade
evidence_boundary: PBC clinical treatment recommendation is not supported without target-directed efficacy and PBC-specific safety evidence

title: Screen-wide signal-level colocalization and model QC
evidence_boundary: Combinations sharing a PBC locus are not independent; relaxed priors do not upgrade the locked strict-prior class; non-convergent estimates are not inferential.

title: Ten-locus local signed-LD and SuSiE QC
evidence_boundary: Signed LD can be negative while absolute credible-set purity is high; 1000G EUR is external reference LD, not discovery-study-specific LD.

title: Competing genes and locus downgrading
evidence_boundary: Repeated gene-cell combinations at one locus are correlated evidence; signal sharing does not establish a causal transcript or druggability.

title: Activation-state and cross-autoimmune mechanistic context
primary_source: data/derived/figures/supplementary/FigS04A-FigS04E; ENCODE; Open Targets; response-eQTL and cross-trait derived tables
evidence_boundary: Regulatory and cross-trait context does not establish allele-specific mediation or a formal genotype-by-stimulation interaction.

title: FinnGen and UKB multilevel replication QC
evidence_boundary: BF-BF is a single-causal approximation, not FinnGen coloc.susie; complete unthresholded Finnish signed LD was unavailable.

title: Splicing and cross-platform protein conflict
primary_source: data/derived/analysis/molecular_qtl/il12rb2/16_il12rb2_sqtl_neighboring_splice_audit; allele-direction chain; MESA aligned cis variants; MESA colocalization sensitivity
evidence_boundary: Circulating or cerebrospinal-fluid assay direction cannot be used to infer cell-surface IL12RB2 abundance or pharmacologic direction.

title: TYK2 LD bootstrap and population sensitivity
evidence_boundary: Intervals propagate reference-LD uncertainty only; 1000G FIN is not FinnGen study-specific signed LD.

title: HRA008003 BAM reconstruction and QC
evidence_boundary: Controls are peritumoral hemangioma surgical liver, not healthy-volunteer biopsy tissue.

title: Target-independent liver cell annotation
evidence_boundary: Composition is descriptive; no differential-abundance claim. The locked archive contained no integrated UMAP coordinates for this supplementary analysis.

title: Donor-level pseudobulk sensitivity
evidence_boundary: No IL12RB2 contrast passes transcriptome-wide FDR 0.05; sensitivity analyses are not independent replications.

title: External Andrews donor-level pseudobulk
evidence_boundary: Two PBC donors and uneven normal immune-cell coverage support external directional evidence, not confirmatory differential expression.

title: Bulk transcriptomic and pathway context
evidence_boundary: Bulk results support direction and heterogeneity, not a diagnostic or prognostic biomarker.

title: PXD083842 robustness and confounding
evidence_boundary: Age and recruitment source are structurally confounded with disease; absence from FDR-only lists is not effect reversal.
